comment: M7-001: prototype is the legacy-compatibility profession (empty starting_skill_ranks - the legacy four attacks are not skill-gated). fighter starts with launcher_z at rank 1 (the Z launcher is granted at creation; the other five hotbar skills must be purchased with SP). mesh_path/skeleton_path are empty with asset_placeholder=true because the DNFArt meshes are imported by the later gameplay-integration task, not by the config base; a non-empty path must live under /Game/UEMMO/ and must not carry the placeholder flag. presentation_id is empty in this card (hit presentations for skills arrive with M7-003).
